name: formento-marketplace
description: Self-hosted single-plugin marketplace for Formento — a checkpoint-gated pipeline that rebuilds a form-heavy app from a spec.

plugins.name: formento
plugins.description: A checkpoint-gated pipeline that rebuilds a form-heavy app from a spec — either from scratch or by pointing at an existing codebase — through six phases (Intent, Schema, UI, Backend, Integration, Deploy), with independent review at every phase and nothing proceeding without explicit approval.
